name: Bad Berleburg (Germany)
description: Hanging banner divided vertically white and black, charged in the upper part with the city arms of Bad Berleburg (a bear on white below black pales and a lion).
history: On 25 June 1976 a banner was approved for the city, described as white and black striped in the ratio 1:1 with the city shield in the middle of the upper half.

features.role: Bad Berleburg arms — bear, pales and lion
